correctness.rationale: An exact cellular integral cochain model, explicit shuffle signs and a support-determinant twist establish the G-action. Induced path forests have free reduced degree-zero cohomology; complete integral component bases decompose invariant supports into regular and at most one sign-twisted line. Edge incidence counting and symmetric-subset counting give the stated binomial multiplicities. The verified standalone checker reproduces ranks/traces and exact sign identities for all enumerated inputs but is not used as proof of the infinite case.

value.rationale: A canonical infinite family of chordal flag complexes acquires a complete all-degree integral symmetry-lattice classification. Distinguishing regular/trivial/sign summands is stronger than the known nonequivariant wedge type and rational Betti ranks, and yields natural finite-symmetry quotient cohomology dimensions with explicit parity effects. No arbitrary parameter slice or invented downstream application is required.
